title: One Becomes Many

sources.title: Break Yurgir's Contract
markers: A party member must read the book

summary: Read at the ritual circle to open the rat encounter in Break Yurgir’s Contract.

fields.Quest use: At the base of the Shar statue, read this book and interact with the Broken Effigy. Either order works and the DC 14 Arcana check only identifies the ritual. The quest walkthrough describes lighting the ritual candles. A rat appears with a bargain. Accept to learn a hidden treasure location, or defeat the rat waves and Lyrthindor to finish the contract route. The encounter is available even if Yurgir has died. Accepting normally lets the rat leave and ends that fight route. The quest walkthrough reports that attacking before the rat flees can preserve both outcomes.
fields.Acquisition: Gauntlet of Shar, near the statue’s base at X −707, Y −723.
